trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: Earn the other 54 trophies. Nothing else unlocks it: the platinum pops the moment the last one does.

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: Play the opening mission, Gone Fishing. It is the first mission of the game and cannot be missed.

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 1. It pops when the chapter's last mission ends.

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 2. Story only; chapter trophies can pop at the start of the next chapter rather than on the last cutscene.

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 3. Story only.

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 4. Story only.

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: Finish the final story mission. Keep a manual save from just before it - there is no mission replay, so this is the point of no return for a clean run.
trophies.when: Story - unmissable; keep a save before it.

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: Finish the story mission Breakfast Run. Unmissable; it pops as you play.

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide: Finish the story mission The Cartel Heist. Unmissable.

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: Finish the story mission Child's Play. Unmissable.

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide: Finish the story mission Headliners. Unmissable.

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide: Finish the story mission VCIA Takedown. Unmissable.

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide: Finish the story mission Operation Savage Glory. Unmissable.

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: Reach 100% completion. The checklist appears under Progress > Stats > 100% Completion only after the story, but work done earlier still counts. It needs 300 stunts, 70 of the 80 Challenges, 200 of the 277 vehicles, all 8 bank vaults, all 39 illegal operations and more - roughly 60% of true completion by PowerPyx's estimate. Budget about 100 hours after the story.
trophies.when: After the story; nothing on the checklist is missable.

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Complete 250 stunts. Stunt jumps, under-bridge flights, knife flights and base jumps all count. Keep going to 300 - the 100% checklist needs 300.
trophies.when: Any time; keep going past 250 for 100%.

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try each type of activity once. Sample every activity the game offers - races, fishing, arcade, shooting range, drone races and the rest - one go at each is enough.

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in all 42 Shooting Range challenges. Two ranges share the 42 medals between them. Learn each range's weapon and scoring, then clear them one by one.

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location. There are 14 drone race locations; win at least once at each.

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Win 20 different races. Any 20 distinct race events count - street, off-road and water races all feed it.

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. Find Cal's fishing challenge and out-fish him; keep your line steady and reel when the fish runs.

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Complete an arcade game. Play any arcade cabinet through to the end of one game.

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Andy. Andy's questline is Lucia-only and stays open after the story.

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Kenton. Kenton's questline stays open after the story.

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Billy. Billy's questline stays open after the story.

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers. Only some questlines count - Andy's, Billy's and Tyrone's have their own trophies and do not count here. Watch the trophy's progress counter after each strand you finish. Do the time-sensitive Race Against Yago in Chapter 3 as soon as it appears (hourglass icon).

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Randy. Randy's questline stays open after the story.

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Tyrone. Tyrone's questline is Jason-only and stays open after the story.

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at every spot across Leonida. There are 18 spots in 10 locations; meditation spots show as purple icons when you are close. Bring your partner - each outdoor spot counts twice if you meditate there with both Jason and Lucia. THE missable one: Lucia's balcony meditation in Chapter 1 disappears after that chapter, so accept it when she walks out to the balcony after the mission Down to Earth, and keep a Chapter 1 save until the trophy pops.
trophies.when: MISSABLE: Lucia's balcony meditation (Chapter 1) is gone after Chapter 1.

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt a unique animal for Bret. Bret Vogel's hunting questline is Jason-only and sends you after animals through target decks. A clean head or heart shot keeps the carcass pristine.

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Complete 3 Collectible Card sets. Find and collect the cards scattered across Leonida; three full sets is the goal.

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: WAiNK It at 100 locations. Use the WAiNK app to tag 100 different spots as you travel.

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Complete 50 Challenges. Challenges are listed under Progress > Challenges - 80 in eight categories of 10. The 100% checklist needs 70, so keep going past 50; many complete on their own while you play.

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Lose a 4-star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat. Easiest during a bank vault job - vaults always bring 4 stars, and escaping one with your partner pops this too. It only counts once you have left the red heat zone, not just the flashing search area.
trophies.when: Any time; easiest during a vault job.

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level. Call your partner, then rob three shops in a row while the police are still chasing you. If the stars fade and you are only in the red heat zone, the chain breaks. It can take about 30 seconds to pop after the third shop.

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles. Scanning a vehicle with the WAiNK app counts as discovering it, so scan traffic as you drive. The 100% checklist needs 200 of the 277 base models.

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus. Combat Focus is the slow-motion aim - press L3 and R3 while aiming. Pick a group of gang enemies, such as the guards at an illegal operation, and use an assault rifle. Adrenaline extends Focus.

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA. At Vice City International Airport, steal a large passenger plane docked at a boarding bridge - planes parked elsewhere on the airfield do not count. Gates E3 and E4 work. Back out toward the runway, take off, and fly about 1 km from the airport; the trophy is delayed and pops once you are clear. Save first - the police come fast.

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: Kinda hot in these Rhinos: get into a military tank. Tanks are parked on the south side of Mile Zero Air Station, on the island at the far southwest of the map. Save first, get in, and drive and fire until it pops.

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected. The Chapter 3 mission Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs gives you the Snap Gun and opens jewelry store robberies. Use the Snap Gun on a store's locked back door - kicking it in sets off the alarm. Inside the back room, find the note with the safe code, open the safe, and leave unseen. Richardson Jewelry & Diamonds in Vice City is a good target. If someone spots you, reload.

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Rob 5 Bank Vaults and escape. Vaults open through That's Where The Money Is, an optional mission near the end of Chapter 4. Tail an armored security van to a large bank and get into the vault while the guard has it open. You cannot carry all the bags alone, so bring your partner. Every vault job brings a 4-star Wanted Level, so have a fast bike ready. The 100% checklist needs all 8 vaults.

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an Armored Truck and escape. Tail or ambush an armored truck, take it, and get clear of the police. It only pops once you have left the heat zone.

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Explore all of Leonida. Drive, fly and sail into every corner of the map until the whole state is uncovered.

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang. Nine gangs run illegal operations across Leonida; rob one operation from each. The 100% checklist wants all 39 operations, so this pops along the way.

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach. No confirmed method at launch - the description is the only hint, and it may pop while you play normally. Try a beachfront bar on Ocean Beach with a view of the water.
trophies.when: Still unconfirmed - re-checked on launch day, 19 Nov 2026.

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style. No confirmed method at launch. The description points at a showroom escape - likely a smash-and-grab exit from a car dealership.
trophies.when: Still unconfirmed - re-checked on launch day, 19 Nov 2026.

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley. The bowling alley is Kingpin Bowling, an illegal operation visited in Chapter 2. Bring Sticky Bombs. Take all three key valuables: the luxury watch in an office, the shotgun on a table, and the office safe's contents, which you blow open with a Sticky Bomb. Then escape the police. If you leave something behind, the operation comes back later, so it is not missable.

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: A partnership with mass appeal. It should pop when Jason and Lucia both reach maximum Strength. Buy a gym membership and train with your partner - the partner trains alongside you. Unconfirmed at launch; the description is the only hint.
trophies.when: Still unconfirmed - re-checked on launch day, 19 Nov 2026.

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: Choices made (for better or worse). It counts 500 actions that change your Criminal Profile - robberies and fights feed it, so it fills up without a separate grind.
trophies.when: Any time; fills up through normal play.

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.guide: Second time's the charm. No confirmed method at launch; the description hints at succeeding on a second attempt at something.
trophies.when: Still unconfirmed - re-checked on launch day, 19 Nov 2026.

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide: A UFO abduction random event in Kelly County, just east of Port Gellhorn. Go there after 2:00am in-game and look for a car parked by the road with its lights flickering. Follow the trail from the car into the woods and a UFO abduction scene plays out: Jason wakes up in a field, gets a worried call from Lucia, and the trophy pops. Confirmed on launch day by a player video (HarryNinetyFour); so far a single video, so the exact trigger may need a few tries - if nothing happens, sleep at home to reach midnight and try again after 2am.
trophies.when: Free roam, after 2am in-game. Launch-day player report.

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by. No confirmed method at launch. The name and description point at bowling pins knocked down with a melee attack from a moving vehicle - try it at a bowling alley.
trophies.when: Still unconfirmed - re-checked on launch day, 19 Nov 2026.

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts. Marked bills come from bank and payday loan jobs and are laundered by selling them to your contacts. The $250,000 total is cumulative.

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops. The total is cumulative across every kind of shop.

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Purchase all garage properties. Buy the eight garages in the Vice City Real Estate app, which unlocks after the Chapter 2 mission Daily Driver. Together they cost about $160,000. Garages the story gives you do not count.

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. The Chapter 2 mission Moses opens the Scooter Bros app. Take a stolen car to Moses, choose Respray, then Register. From Chapter 3 you can also register cars with a standard tracker at Pay 'n' Spray. Each car needs a free garage space, so buy garages first and register cheap cars.
